title: Wellness Membership Billing Terms: Draft Days, Grace, Retry and Late Fee
content:
Wellness Membership dues are drafted on the 1st or the 15th of the month, and all six tiers carry the same billing and payment terms.

| Tier | Billing days available | Automatic draft required | HSA or FSA card accepted for dues | Grace after a failed draft before past due | Retry of a failed draft | Late fee per period that becomes past due | Days past due after which the membership is cancelled |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Open Gym Access Membership | 1st or 15th | Yes | No | 7 calendar days | 3 calendar days later | 10.00 | 60 calendar days |
| Aquatic Access Membership | 1st or 15th | Yes | No | 7 calendar days | 3 calendar days later | 10.00 | 60 calendar days |
| Wellness Essentials Membership | 1st or 15th | Yes | No | 7 calendar days | 3 calendar days later | 10.00 | 60 calendar days |
| Wellness Plus Membership | 1st or 15th | Yes | No | 7 calendar days | 3 calendar days later | 10.00 | 60 calendar days |
| Performance Membership | 1st or 15th | Yes | No | 7 calendar days | 3 calendar days later | 10.00 | 60 calendar days |
| Performance Plus Membership | 1st or 15th | Yes | No | 7 calendar days | 3 calendar days later | 10.00 | 60 calendar days |

## Key to the columns

- **Billing days available**: the days of the month on which dues may be drafted, the 1st or the 15th.
- **Automatic draft required**: dues are drafted automatically from a card or a bank account.
- **HSA or FSA card**: health savings account and flexible spending account cards are not accepted for dues on any tier.
- **Grace**: the number of calendar days after a failed draft before the membership is past due (7).
- **Retry**: the number of calendar days after a failed draft before it is retried (3).
- **Late fee**: 10.00, billed once per billing period that becomes past due.
- **Cancellation of a past-due membership**: the number of calendar days past due after which the membership is cancelled (60).

## Quick figures

| Term | Figure |
|---|---|
| Billing days | 1 or 15 |
| Grace | 7 calendar days |
| Retry | 3 calendar days |
| Late fee | 10.00 once per period |
| Past-due cancellation | 60 calendar days |
